messages.author: 82933c06b1097cc4
messages.subject: clonecorrect error
parts:
Hi,

I formatted my file in gfenalex format and input my files as follows
x <-getfile()

continent_o  <- read.genalex(x$files, sep = ",")

When I used "poppr"  function it showed it's a geneclone project, 

However, when I used continent_cc <- clonecorrect(continent_o, combine=TRUE), I got the warning message 

Warning message:

In popsub(pop, x) : Nothing present in the sublist.
 Perhaps the sublist and blacklist arguments have duplicate entries?
 Subset not taking place.

Could anybody tell me what is wrong?

Jennifer

messages.author: d192ec4b1d416345
messages.subject: Re: [poppr] clonecorrect error
parts:
Hi Jennifer,

Can you please provide the version of poppr and R you have installed? If you don't have version 2.5.0, try re-installing poppr. 
This warning shouldn't appear from a call to clonecorrect, so I have a couple of follow up questions:

How many population strata do you have? Are they split?
If you type all.equal(pop(continent_o), strata(continent_o)[[1]]), is the result TRUE?

Additionally, if you wouldn't mind confidentially sharing your data with me, I may be able to determine why this warning is appearing.

Thanks,
Zhian

-----

messages.author: d192ec4b1d416345
messages.subject: Re: [poppr] clonecorrect error
parts:
Hi, 

instead of 

Bly_stra<-as.data.frame(Bly_snpclo$pop)

you should use

Bly_stra <- as.data.frame(pop = pop(Bly_snpclo))

The strata slot contains a data frame with named columns. The error message is telling you that it can't find the column named "pop" because the only columns you have are called "Bly_snpclo.pop". This was because you didn't name the column when you created the strata.

-----
